svg.title: Black Relief Over White II
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG after inspecting a public publisher PDF plate. Approximate contour and interpretive palette. White backing rectangle and two joined black facets retained; casts shadows and perspective omitted. Plate PDF page23 follows caption page22. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of black, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference:https://archive.org/download/EllsworthKelly20132/EllsworthKelly20132.pdf#page=22; visually inspected2026-10-27; editable interpretation, not a facsimile.
